OUR STORY

From the Heart

A Letter for Sarah

My Dearest Sarah,

There is no one in this world who makes my heart feel more at home than you do. Every moment we have shared, every laugh, every quiet evening side by side — that is us. That is love. You are extraordinary, Sarah. You have given so much of yourself and made every single day brighter just by being in it. The way you love is rare and beautiful, and I never want to take a single moment of it for granted. On this anniversary I want you to know that you are forever cherished. Not just for what you do — but for who you are. Thank you for every memory, every hug, and every moment by my side. Thank you for being my everything. I love you so much.

Cody ❤️
